title: South Korea’s Kospi index jumps more than 16% on a surge of chipmaking stocks
description: South Korea’s Kospi index has jumped more than 16% as artificial intelligence-related stocks bounced back after losses earlier this week. U.S. futures edged higher and oil prices rose Friday. Shares of South Korean technology giant Samsung Electronics surged 24.8%, while memory chipmaker SK Hynix soared 27.8%. The Kospi index had plummeted more than 16% on Tuesday and Wednesday on a sell-off of technology stocks in part over worries about an AI bubble and rising intensive competition from chipmaking rivals in China. Tokyo’s Nikkei 225 also climbed 5.5% in early Friday trading. In the U.S. on Thursday, Wall Street’s benchmark S&P 500 rose 1.7%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average added 1.2%. The technology-heavy Nasdaq composite gained 2.8%.
